reasons: Rule is a 'missing' insert and the record supports it: para 4(c)(i)-(iv) only addresses cessation of Services, license revocation and mutual Confidential Information return/destruction, with no transition assistance, data return or deletion certification anywhere cited.

The inserted sub-clauses (v)-(vii) track the playbook model language closely — six (6) months of transition assistance at Kubient's then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a commonly used machine-readable format within thirty (30) days, and subsequent deletion with written certification — reaching the preferred position with a minimal, additive edit.

Insertion is correctly located in the termination-effects section, is drafted in the counterparty's own vocabulary (Requests, Content, Properties, Inventory, Impressions) and defines 'Customer Data' inline since the Agreement lacks that term.
Comment is accurate, concise, in first person plural with the [Playbook] prefix, explains the change, cites the playbook position and offers the 90-day fallback without lecturing.
Minor drafting nit only (clause (iv) begins with 'and', so appending (v)-(vii) after it reads slightly awkwardly); this does not affect enforceability or the substantive position.
